name: Sarah & Duck
description: Sarah is a 7-year-old girl with big eyes and a green hat. She lives with her best friend, a quacky, slightly manic fowl appropriately named Duck. Each episode features the pair setting out on simple but exciting adventures as they explore the world in their own imaginative way.

videos.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
videos.overview: The Shallots from Sarah & Duck perform the lullaby Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.

videos.title: If You’re Happy and You Know It
videos.overview: The Shallots from Sarah & Duck dance to the nursery rhyme If You’re Happy and You Know It.

videos.title: One Potato, Two Potato
videos.overview: The Shallots from Sarah & Duck perform the song One Potato, Two Potato with the Bug Band!

videos.title: Birthday Song
videos.overview: Sarah, Duck and all of their friends sing an extended version of the birthday song!

videos.title: Autocat Returns
videos.overview: Sleepy Duck! All he wants is peace and quiet, but a robotic furry friend has other ideas.

videos.title: Duckzilla

videos.title: Leaf Chase
videos.overview: Duck and Flamingo go head to head in pursuit of a very special prize!
